harridan.name: Harridan
harridan.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly <HIVE FLEET> GARGOYLE models.

hierophant-bio-titan.name: Hierophant Bio-titan
hierophant-bio-titan.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly <HIVE FLEET> GENESTEALERS, TERMAGANTS, HORMAGAUNTS, HIVE GUARD, TYRANT GUARD or TYRANID WARRIORS models. Each HIVE GUARD, TYRANT GUARD or TYRANID WARRIOR model takes up the space of 3 other models. It can also transport 1 friendly <HIVE FLEET> TYRANID PRIME or BROODLORD.

synapse.name: Synapse
synapse.text: TYRANID HIVE FLEETS units in this Detachment automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 12" of a friendly SYNAPSE unit.

brood-telepathy.name: Brood Telepathy
brood-telepathy.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by <HIVE FLEET> GENESTEALER units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <HIVE FLEET> units with this ability.

hive-commander.name: Hive Commander
hive-commander.text: Morale tests taken for friendly <HIVE FLEET> units are automatically passed whilst they are within 18" of this unit.

alpha-warrior.name: Alpha Warrior
alpha-warrior.text: Alpha Warrior: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by <HIVE FLEET> TYRANID WARRIOR units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

brood-progenitor.name: Brood Progenitor
brood-progenitor.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with ranged weapons by friendly <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANT units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

synaptic-backlash.name: Synaptic Backlash
synaptic-backlash.text: If this unit is destroyed, place one blast marker next to every friendly <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANT unit within 6" of this unit before removing it from the battlefield.

spawn-termagants.name: Spawn Termagants
spawn-termagants.text: Once per turn, at the start of the Set Up Reinforcements step of the Orders phase, this unit can spawn Termagants. If it does, add a new unit of 10 TERMAGANT models equipped with Fleshborers to your army: it is part of this unit's Detachment and has the <HIVE FLEET> keyword. Set the new unit up on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 1" from enemy units. If the unit cannot be placed in this way, it is destroyed. Then roll a D6; on a 1-3 this unit cannot use this ability again this battle.

alpha-leader.name: Alpha Leader
alpha-leader.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <HIVE FLEET> CARNIFEX units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

hungering-swarm.name: Hungering Swarm
hungering-swarm.text: If this unit contains 30 models, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit.

shieldwall.name: Shieldwall
shieldwall.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly <HIVE FLEET> HIVE TYRANT unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that HIVE TYRANT unit and place them next to this unit.

shrouding-spores.name: Shrouding Spores
shrouding-spores.text: Friendly LIGHT <HIVE FLEET> and HEAVY <HIVE FLEET> units have the Stealth ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit. If this unit contains 6 models, the range of this ability is increased by 3".

toxic-miasma.name: Toxic Miasma
toxic-miasma.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of any enemy units with this ability; on a 6 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

rapacious-hunger.name: Rapacious Hunger
rapacious-hunger.text: When an enemy LIGHT unit is destroyed whilst in base contact with this unit, if this unit has at least one damage marker next to it, remove one damage marker from this unit.

feeding-frenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
feeding-frenzy.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <HIVE FLEET> RAVENER units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

floating-death-mucolid-spores.name: Floating Death (Mucolid Spores)
floating-death-mucolid-spores.text: After a Move action (made by any unit), if this unit is within 3" of an enemy unit, roll one D6 for each model in this unit. For each 2 or 3 place one blast marker next to the closest enemy unit, and for each 4+ place two blast markers next to the closest enemy unit. Then, this unit is destroyed.

floating-death-spore-mines.name: Floating Death (Spore Mines)
floating-death-spore-mines.text: After a Move action (made by any unit), if this unit is within 3" of an enemy unit, roll one D6 for each model in this unit. For each 3+ place one blast marker next to the closest enemy unit. Then, this unit is destroyed.

weapon-beast-exocrine.name: Weapon Beast (Exocrine)
weapon-beast-exocrine.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, double the Attacks characteristic of its Bio-plasmic Cannon for that action.

weapon-beast-tyrannofex.name: Weapon Beast (Tyrannofex)
weapon-beast-tyrannofex.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, double the Attacks characteristic of its Acid Spray, Fleshborer Hive, Rupture Cannon and Stinger Salvo for that action.

hypertoxic-miasma.name: Hypertoxic Miasma
hypertoxic-miasma.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of any enemy units with this ability; on a 5+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.text: When this unit makes a Move action, it can borrow instead of moving. If it does, it is removed from the battlefield and placed into Tactical Reserves. When this unit arrives as reinforcements, set it up as described in the Terror from the Deep ability. A unit cannot burrow if it was set up on the battlefield this turn, if there are any enemy units in base contact with it, or if there are any blast markers next to it.

terror-from-the-deep.name: Terror from the Deep
terror-from-the-deep.text: When this unit uses the Deep Strike ability, you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 1" away from any enemy units, instead of 9". After setting this unit up using the Deep Strike ability, if there are any enemy units within 3" of it, select one of those units and roll one D12. On a 3-5 place one blast marker next to that unit, on a 6-9 place two blast markers next to that unit and on a 10+ place three blast markers next to that unit.

transport-spore.name: Transport Spore
transport-spore.text: When this unit is set up in Tactical Reserves, you can also set up a friendly <HIVE FLEET> INFANTRY unit of up to 20 models or a <HIVE FLEET> MONSTER unit with a Wounds characteristic of 4 or less inside it (this cannot be a Tyrannocyte or Sporocyst). When this unit uses its Deep Strike ability, set any unit inside it up on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from enemy units. If that unit cannot be placed in this way, it is destroyed.

spore-mine-cysts.name: Spore Mine Cysts
spore-mine-cysts.text: After this unit makes a Move action, you can select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll one D6; on a 3+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

immobile-2.name: Immobile
immobile-2.text: This unit is never Out of Command: an Out of Command marker is never placed next to it.

bio-fortress.name: Bio-fortress
bio-fortress.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, it can target enemy units in base contact with it.

toxic-miasma-2.name: Toxic Miasma
toxic-miasma-2.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D6 for each unit within 6" of any enemy units with this ability; on a 5+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

shrouding-spores-2.name: Shrouding Spores
shrouding-spores-2.text: Friendly LIGHT <HIVE FLEET> and HEAVY <HIVE FLEET> units have the Stealth ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

living-bombs.name: Living Bombs
living-bombs.text: Morale tests taken for this unit are automatically passed.

floating-death-meiotic-spores.name: Floating Death (Meiotic Spores)
floating-death-meiotic-spores.text: After a Move action (made by any unit), if this unit is within 3" of an enemy unit, roll one D6 for each model in this unit. For each 2 or 3 place one blast marker next to the closest enemy unit, and for each 4+ place two blast markers next to the closest enemy unit. Then, this unit is destroyed.

monstrous-brood.name: Monstrous Brood
monstrous-brood.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
sky-attack.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll one D6; on a 2+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

frenzied-metabolism.name: Frenzied Metabolism
frenzied-metabolism.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, you can place one blast marker next to this unit. If you do so, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit for that action.

incendiary-ichor.name: Incendiary Ichor
incendiary-ichor.text: Each time a blast marker is placed next to this unit, if there are any enemy units in base contact with this unit, roll one D6; on a 3+ place one blast marker next to an enemy unit in base contact with this unit.

the-will-of-the-hive-mind.name: The Will of the Hive Mind
the-will-of-the-hive-mind.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

warp-field.name: Warp Field
warp-field.text: Roll D12s when making saving throws for this unit, irrespective of the size of the blast markers next to it.

acid-blood.name: Acid Blood
acid-blood.text: When a blast marker is placed next to this unit, if it is in base contact with any enemy units, select one of those units and roll one D6. On a 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

hail-of-living-ammunition.name: Hail of Living Ammunition
hail-of-living-ammunition.text: If this unit contains 30 models, re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit.

chitin-thorns.name: Chitin Thorns
chitin-thorns.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll a D6 for each unit within 6" of any enemy units with Chitin Thorns; on a 6 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.
